claim_boundary.highest_claim: Agent 2 route-data plan for Orot top reader-hint gaps using existing pipeline tools and current route-card audit evidence

required_row_fields_for_answer_slot_cand: candidate_status=accepted only after pipeline evidence review; proposed rows are disambiguation evidence and do not fill the answer slot
answer_eligible=true only for boundary-safe answer-slot candidates
definition or route_definition or paraphrase populated from pipeline source evidence, not hand-authored text
source_rows with source_id, source_url, license, license_url
answer_contract_repair_target.non_answer_route_card_reason: scripts/build_hud_route_store.mjs hard-codes phrase_evidence cards as answer_eligible=false and answer_role=evidence; the reader-hint consumer also excludes phrase_evidence from answer-slot selection.
do_not_do: Do not flip answer_eligible on existing phrase_evidence rows.
Do not flip answer_eligible on form_reference rows.
Do not relabel answer_role=evidence rows into answer rows unless the producing pipeline can create a boundary-safe answer-candidate row with public source/license/citation and renderable answer text.
Do not patch data/definitions/hud-route-lookup shards directly as the source of truth.

repair_classes.repair: Generate separate citable_paraphrase_evidence or definition claim rows if pipeline evidence can support a reader-answer candidate; leave phrase_evidence as evidence.
Regenerate or adjust upstream citable paraphrase rows only when candidate_status, boundary_safe, answer_role, answer_eligible, source rows, and renderable answer fields satisfy the answer contract.
Keep form_reference rows non-answer; create a separate lemma, morphology, or citable answer candidate if the pipeline can substantiate it.

disambiguation_target.repair_rule: Disambiguation must change route-card evidence or scores so one candidate is no longer tied within the same lookup relation and score window, or mark non-selected candidates answer_eligible=false/answer_role=evidence through pipeline evidence. Do not hand-pick highest score as truth.

recommended_execution_sequence.action: Create or refresh a bounded top-gap evidence queue from the Agent 10 audit token IDs, preserving token_id, focus_normalized, route_card_count, answer_eligible_count, ambiguity_count, and blocker.
recommended_execution_sequence.write_scope: reports/agent2-* or .local-cache/definition-routes/* only; do not write public deploy files.

recommended_execution_sequence.action: For the 18 contract-repair tokens, add or regenerate source-citable paraphrase candidate rows only when existing pipeline source evidence can populate source/license rows and a renderable candidate answer field.
For the 6 ambiguous tokens, emit a non-authority disambiguation evidence packet first. Only after evidence separates candidates should route-card fields or scores change.
For tok-35f6d9093072, generate new pipeline route rows keyed to the lookup candidates; do not invent a definition if no source-backed row can be created.
After route input changes only, rebuild local route store and lookup, then validate route data before any Agent 10 public dry-run.
Run public-reader dry-runs only after Agent 2 local route data changes and validators pass.

blockers: No dedicated existing disambiguation writer was identified; ambiguity repair currently has to be expressed as route-card data or score changes consumed by build_public_hud_reader_hints.mjs.

Rows with route_type=phrase_evidence are intentionally non-answer evidence under build_hud_route_store.mjs and should not be relabeled into answers without new source-backed citable/definition route rows.

The second Agent 10 audit shows 338 cards are explicitly answer_eligible=false and 431 cards carry answer_role=evidence; safe repair requires upstream answer-candidate rows or contract-safe route-data adjustments, not direct flag flips.
Any row that would require human semantic choice rather than pipeline evidence should remain proposed/disambiguation evidence and not become answer_eligible.
